exercises synthetic plumbing. Live mode is always explicit. Policy decisions
recommend acceptance or human review; they perform no action.

positional arguments:
  {init,run,evaluate,replay}
    init                Create synthetic examples in an empty directory.
    replay              Recompute a historical decision without network
                        access.
